product_one_liner.value: Rivo helps households automatically earn on idle cash by moving money from their existing bank accounts into short-term U.S. Treasury bills and returning it before bills are due.

pricing_page.notes: No dedicated pricing page or pricing navigation link was found; fees are publicly disclosed in the FAQ.

named_customers.notes: Ritwik Tewari explicitly identifies himself as a customer; the other two names are App Store reviewer handles, not verified legal names.

employee_band.notes: The published company size is 1–10 employees, with 8 employees reported; none of the permitted bands fits.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index contains consumer-finance, product and marketing articles, not two qualifying engineer-authored posts about building the product.

public_docs.notes: Only a standalone FAQ was found, not a public multi-article documentation site or developer portal; the docs and help subdomains yielded no readable pages.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: No public careers page or job board was located. Historical founder recruiting posts and general engineer recruiting do not establish a live AI/ML requisition.

model_provider.notes: No model or provider disclosure was found in the product pages, FAQ, blog or privacy policy. The FAQ references a Trust Center subprocessor list, but that list could not be located publicly.

compliance_certs.notes: The FAQ explicitly claims SOC 2 compliance; no audit type or report is specified.

last_funding.notes: The August 4, 2026 announcement states a $2.7 million seed round and $3.1 million total funding; the total is not the round amount.

raised_18mo.notes: The seed announcement is dated August 4, 2026, within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: No public careers page or job board was located, and no live qualifying sales requisition was verified.

launched_6mo.notes: Rivo announced its public launch out of beta on August 4, 2026; its September 7 company blog also announces the public launch. Both fall within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No dated C-level or VP-level arrival or departure was verified for November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026. Leadership biographies and the team announcement do not establish all relevant start dates.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable content-creator recruiting post names social publishing channels but no CRM, sales-engagement or marketing-automation system.
